tbesh_html:
1) majesty
1a) a rising up (of column of smoke)
1b) a swelling (of sea)
1c) majesty (of God)
1d) pride

strongs_1890.derivation: from H1342 (גָּאָה); the same as H1346 (גַּאֲוָה)xlit gaʻăvâh corrected to gaʼăvâh
strongs_1890.kjv_def: excellent things, lifting up, majesty, pride, proudly, raging.
